lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap using the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents volunteered geographic information collected and edited by OSM contributors, with AI-assisted mapping estimates applied to assess coverage completeness. Data currency averages 4 years with recent updates in the last 6 months.
